Chapter 1226 - 34: It’S Simple, Just Sweep Through (Please Subscribe)

Chapter 1226: Chapter 34: It’s simple, just sweep through (Please subscribe)

"Self-destruction by choice?"

Lin Yuan gazed down at the gradually dispersing Chaos Flame, his thoughts stirring like ripples.

For a Chaos Great Saint to willingly annihilate themselves, it’s incredibly difficult. Could their Dao heart be so unyielding having reached chaos realm perfection?

Such a powerful figure can be killed, can be suppressed, but for them to willingly self-annihilate is almost impossible.

Back then, Xuanhuang perished due to the backlash from forcibly breaking free of the time loop, but the Nine Phoenix Great Saint?

He willingly walked towards annihilation right in front of Lin Yuan.

This was indeed because of Lin Yuan’s strength, but even if not an opponent, no Chaos Great Saint would willingly walk towards self-annihilation.

For example, Lin Yuan, even when faced with a supreme being of time, would surely resist and struggle if there was no way out, rather than surrender.

In the timeline scenes seen by the Sky Void Tripod, Lin Yuan, after completely destroying that special place, willingly annihilated his physical and spiritual body, because he still had a fallback in the source world.

It was not true death.

Yet the Nine Phoenix Great Saint...

Lin Yuan could clearly sense that the burning of the Nine Phoenix Great Saint was thorough, leaving nothing related to their own karma to save themselves.

As for ’reincarnation’?

Lin Yuan also didn’t sense any trace of spiritual will merging into the rules of the Chaos Void for reincarnation.

This means that the Nine Phoenix Great Saint was heading toward complete death and extinction.

"The karma has ended."

Lin Yuan looked at the quickly dispersing Chaos Flame, feeling the lack of any trace of karma from the two Chaos Great Saints, and thought silently.

From the early destruction of the homeland universe to the difficult integration of human civilization into the Chaos Void, it all stemmed from these two Chaos Great Saints.

Now that the other has completely fallen, the grievances and karma between the two are settled.

Hoo~

The Chaos Flame dissipated.

A crystalline, translucent crimson crystal stone appeared there.

Lin Yuan glanced at it, extended his right hand, and took the crimson translucent crystal stone in his hand.

The crystal contains threads of Chaos Flame. Though not much, it is extremely pure.

"Is this the condensation of the Nine Phoenix Great Saint’s lifetime Tao Fruit?"

Lin Yuan looked at the crystal stone. No matter what kind of being, whether below the twelfth level or seeking to dominate chaos, as long as they merge with this crystal, they can quickly tread the path of chaos power evolution that the Nine Phoenix Great Saint followed.

Simply put, this crystal stone can quickly create a Chaos Great Saint.

Such a treasure, even Lin Yuan had only heard of it, never seen it before.

Even invincible Great Saints like Xuanhuang and the Moyu Tower Master had never seen it.

Because it’s extremely difficult.

It requires a fully perfected chaos realm at full strength to willingly give up everything, abandon the thirteenth level attempt, give up reincarnation, etc., to have the hope of condensing it.

And to make a Chaos Great Saint do this is almost impossible.

Moreover, the most critical point is, even if this Chaos Great Saint is willing to do so, they may not be able to finally condense such a Tao Fruit.

"If one’s Dao can continue, then it is not a complete demise."

Lin Yuan looked at the crimson crystal stone in his hand, put it into his inner universe, and then turned to return to the Galaxy Chaos Continent.

...

Source World.

Within a treasured land.

As the true self of the Chaos Void entered the Chaos Realm, the true self in this source world naturally also stepped into the Chaos Realm.

"This space-time?"

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged, feeling the vast power within him.

After stepping into the Chaos Realm, the essence of life transformed and leaped forward.

Lin Yuan once again felt the suppression of the treasured land’s space-time on him becoming almost negligible.

"The Primordial Lands of the Source World..."

Lin Yuan’s gaze was deep, vaguely seeing further into the space-time through this treasured land.

The essence of the treasured land is that it falls off from the source world. If the source world is compared to a towering tree, then the treasured land is like the fruit on the tree.

The fallen fruit, already disconnected from the towering tree, refers to places like the Hei Yu Nest and other treasured lands.

But at present, this treasured land has just emerged, maintaining a state of being both detached and not detached from the source world.

With Lin Yuan’s current realm, through this half-disconnected link, he could perceive some of the essence of the towering tree that is the source world itself.

Buzz~

At this moment.

An incarnation of Su Yin Heavenly Venerate from the Xuanyin Ancient Country descended.

"Galaxy Venerate, have you made up your mind yet?"

Su Yin Heavenly Venerate was somewhat impatient.

Ever since six hundred years ago, when he planned to use the core sky pillar occupied by his own ancient country to trade with Galaxy Venerate while taking the opportunity to gain substantial benefits,

this Galaxy Venerate had been considering, claiming that such a major matter was not for him to decide.

At first, Su Yin Heavenly Venerate understood, as his demands were indeed excessive, no different from taking advantage of a crisis and making outrageous demands.

Su Yin Heavenly Venerate knew he was making outrageous demands, and Galaxy Venerate and even the Fierce Sun Ancient Country knew he was too, but given the situation within the treasured land, even if Galaxy Venerate and Fierce Sun Ancient Country were unwilling, if they wanted to obtain this treasured land, they could only let them make outrageous demands.

However.

Six hundred years have passed.

Galaxy Venerate kept saying he’s considering.

A straightforward transaction was dragged on for six hundred years by Galaxy Venerate?

This completely exhausted Su Yin Heavenly Venerate’s patience.

If not for the conditions he proposed to the Fierce Sun Ancient Country far surpassing those proposed to the Da Fu Ancient Country, making the benefits of trading with Galaxy Venerate more attractive from a利益 perspective,

Su Yin Heavenly Venerate would have already turned to complete the transaction with the Da Fu Ancient Country.

"Consider what?"

Lin Yuan glanced at Su Yin Heavenly Venerate.

"Consider what?"

Su Yin Heavenly Venerate was somewhat astonished.

It’s been six hundred years, and the Galaxy Venerate is still considering something?

Could it be that these six hundred years were for nothing?

"Galaxy Venerate, my patience is limited."

Su Yin Heavenly Venerate suppressed the anger in his heart. Even though the Galaxy Venerate is the Strongest Venerable, Su Yin represents not himself, but the Xuanyin Ancient Country.

The Galaxy Venerate’s playful response made Su Yin extremely angry, feeling deceived.

"How dare you speak to me with such attitude?"

Lin Yuan looked at Su Yin Heavenly Venerate.

Bang!

With a wave of Lin Yuan’s hand, a ripple of time and space crushed Su Yin’s avatar.

Su Yin Heavenly Venerate’s avatar shattered instantly.

"Galaxy Venerate, you?"

Soon, Su Yin regathered himself. Given his strength, forming another avatar was nothing.

However, the newly formed Su Yin Heavenly Venerate stared at Lin Yuan in shock and disbelief.

If this were outside the treasure land, speaking to the Strongest Venerable like this would indeed warrant punishment.

But this is inside the treasure land, and the Fierce Sun Ancient Country needs something from the Xuanyin Ancient Country.

In this situation, why would the Galaxy Venerate dare to act so recklessly against his avatar?

Could it be they’ve really given up competing for this treasure land?

But that shouldn’t be the case.

Su Yin Heavenly Venerate knew well that although his demands were excessive, in the long run, it would be beneficial for the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, much better than letting Da Fu Ancient Country acquire this treasure land.

"What I want, I don’t need to obtain through transactions." Lin Yuan glanced at Su Yin Heavenly Venerate, then said impatiently, "Get lost already!"

Bang!

Su Yin Heavenly Venerate’s avatar exploded again.

This time, Su Yin Heavenly Venerate did not reappear.

...

"Alright, alright." On the Xuanyin Ancient Country’s side, Su Yin Heavenly Venerate’s eyes were grim. The Galaxy Venerate’s actions and words made him realize that their transaction had basically fallen through.

Although Su Yin didn’t know why the Galaxy Venerate acted this way, the most important thing now was to quickly complete the transaction with Da Fu Ancient Country.

If it drags on and Da Fu Ancient Country learns of this, they might assume the Fierce Sun Ancient Country has perhaps abandoned the fight for this treasure land, and the conditions he proposed might be cut by more than half.

"Galaxy Venerate, Fierce Sun Ancient Country."

Su Yin Heavenly Venerate took a deep breath and immediately sent a consciousness to the giant core sky pillar occupied by Da Fu Ancient Country.

...

Soon after driving away Su Yin Heavenly Venerate.

Spirit Prison Venerable from the Da Ling Ancient Country also descended.

"Galaxy Venerate, have you considered?" Spirit Prison Venerable was also here to urge the transaction. The treasure land competition was nearing its end, so he naturally wanted to complete the transaction quickly.

"No need to consider."

Lin Yuan looked at Spirit Prison Venerable and said directly, "If you want to trade with Da Fu, just go ahead."

"You?"

Spirit Prison Venerable was stunned, not understanding why the Galaxy Venerate said such a thing.

It’s obvious to anyone that if Da Ling Ancient Country completes the trade with Da Fu Ancient Country, Da Fu will have a crushing advantage in core sky pillar refinement.

The Fierce Sun Ancient Country would have no hope left.

In such a situation, any sensible Galaxy Venerate would try to make a deal with Da Ling Ancient Country, wouldn’t they?

"Scram."

Lin Yuan waved his hand, and Spirit Prison Venerable’s avatar immediately disintegrated.

...

"Galaxy, what are you doing?"

Red Flame Venerable came out, puzzled about why Lin Yuan had shattered Su Yin Heavenly Venerate’s avatar, and then Spirit Prison Venerable’s avatar again.

This left Red Flame Venerable somewhat bewildered.

"There’s no need to trade with them."

Lin Yuan looked at Red Flame Venerable, shaking his head as he said, "These ancient country Venerables only know how to make demands."

Aside from other demands, the ask to claim eighty to one hundred percent of the rare treasures produced over the past quadrillion years before fully occupying the treasure land was unacceptable to Lin Yuan.

"The demands are indeed excessive."

Red Flame Venerable was silent for a while.

The Xuanyin Ancient Country and Da Ling Ancient Country had made excessive demands, which was obvious even to the other Fierce Sun Ancient Country Venerables, but they had no choice but to agree if they wanted the treasure land.

"Hmm?"

Red Flame Venerable was about to speak when suddenly his face changed, "Da Fu Ancient Country has already completed transactions with Xuanyin Ancient Country and Da Ling Ancient Country."

"Now it’s all over."

Red Flame Venerable sighed.

The transaction among the three ancient countries wasn’t a secret. In fact, Fu Xu Venerate had actively spread the news.

"These three ancient countries possess nearly 180 core sky pillars, more than half of the total core sky pillar number, plus Thunderclap Ancient Country’s core sky pillars..."

Red Flame Venerable was worried, even showing signs of despair: "How can the Fierce Sun Ancient Country compete with Da Fu Ancient Country for this treasure land..."

Up to this point, Red Flame Venerable saw no hope. Even if the Barbaric Wilderness Country allied with the Fierce Sun Ancient Country to control the core sky pillars, they were far outmatched by the opposition.

"It’s simple....."

Lin Yuan glanced at Red-eyed Venerable and said blandly:

"Just push through."
